tokens.v: Planned orders are free to get wrong.
Re-plan as often as you like; nothing is real until you transfer it. That is the whole reason planning and execution are separate.

tokens.v: Planned orders do not survive a run on merit — every one of them is swept and regenerated. Only confirmed orders, and orders already transferred, persist.

items.text: A rerun deletes and rebuilds. Planned orders do not survive a run on merit — every one of them is swept and regenerated. Only confirmed orders, and orders already transferred, persist.

tokens.v: A missing planning cluster is a silent failure.
The item does not error; it simply never appears in the results. If an item you expect to be planned is absent, check its cluster line before anything else.

items.text: A missing planning cluster is a silent failure. The item does not error; it simply never appears in the results. If an item you expect to be planned is absent, check its cluster line before anything else.

tokens.v: Set the order horizon before you blame the plan.
Demand beyond the horizon is not "missed" — planning is configured not to look that far.

tokens.v: MRP needs to know who to buy from.
